title: E-commerce 360° Sales Engine
summary: A 9-point strategic overhaul to maximize conversion, retention, and organic reach.
description: I executed a full-funnel audit and optimization plan for a Shopify-based brand, focusing on technical speed, user psychology, and automated marketing loops.

grid_modules.title: 1. Speed Optimization
grid_modules.details: High bounce rates were caused by heavy assets. I implemented image lazy-loading, script minification, and app-weight reduction to bring the store to sub-3-second load times.

grid_modules.title: 2. Shopify 2.0 Architecture
grid_modules.details: Migrated the store to Shopify Online Store 2.0. This allows for modular sections on every page, making the site easier to manage and faster for customers to navigate.

grid_modules.title: 3. Custom Liquid Design
grid_modules.details: Instead of using heavy apps like PageFly, I built custom Liquid sections. This provides a 'Beautiful Layout' aesthetic while maintaining maximum site speed.

grid_modules.title: 4. 30-Day Retention Loop
grid_modules.details: Developed an automated '30-day reorder' email sequence. This creates a predictable revenue stream by reminding customers when they are likely running low on product.

grid_modules.title: 5. Mobile UX Overhaul
grid_modules.details: The mobile version was too long. I restructured the vertical hierarchy, moving products and CTAs higher ('above the fold') to reduce scrolling and increase Add-to-Cart rates.

grid_modules.title: 6. Social Proof Engine
grid_modules.details: Implemented a customer review system for every product. Social proof is the #1 driver of conversion for first-time visitors, and reviews now build immediate credibility.

grid_modules.title: 7. Modash Influencers
grid_modules.details: Using Modash, I identified and onboarded niche influencers. This provided a steady stream of highly-qualified traffic that was pre-warmed by trusted creators.

grid_modules.title: 8. Omnisend Growth (SD)
grid_modules.details: Built out the Omnisend strategy for SD. We focused on segmented campaigns that drove a double-digit increase in repeat customer traffic through personalized messaging.

grid_modules.title: 9. SEO Keyword Mastery
grid_modules.details: Performed deep keyword research to optimize every product page. This strategy improved organic rankings, resulting in more 'free' traffic that converts at a higher rate.
